top_signals.title: US Stock Futures Trade Mixed With Focus on CPI, Anthropic IPO
top_signals.summary: US stock futures are struggling for direction after the market’s best day since April ahead of a key inflation report that could pave the path for an interest rate hike by the Federal Reserve as soon as next month.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Inflation expectations impacting rate path, bonds and global risk assets.

top_signals.title: UAE Cuts Flagship Oil Price as Mideast Supply Jump Stirs Rivalry
top_signals.summary: The United Arab Emirates slashed the price premium for December supplies of its flagship oil grade shortly after cuts made by neighboring Saudi Arabia, as rebounding Middle East supplies stir competition for market share.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: U.S. Traders Weigh the Cost of Taking Trump’s Russian Diesel
top_signals.summary: Two tankers carrying Russian diesel have diverted from their intended American destinations, while another remains in the North Atlantic without a declared unloading port, complicating President Donald Trump’s agreement with Vladimir Putin to ease fuel prices. The Treasury has authorized Russian diesel transactions, but lawmakers warn that companies handling U.S. imports could still violate a congressional ban. The Russian tanker Talisman and Sierra Leone-flagged Leruo departed the Baltic port of Primorsk in October, initially declaring destinations…
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: French Tycoons Assail $505 Million Stock Offer to Rubis Partners
top_signals.summary: Rubis SCA’s largest shareholder as well as French billionaires Vincent Bolloré and Xavier Niel are trying to block the fuel retailer’s proposal to grant about €450 million ($505 million) of stock to its general partners if the award isn’t revised lower.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Russian hackers compromised government email servers to steal NATO, EU correspondence
top_signals.summary: Russian state-linked hackers have compromised government email servers in Romania and Kazakhstan  to secretly intercept messages exchanged with NATO and European Union officials, researchers said.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Widespread PHP Flaw May Cause Many Site Outages Today
top_signals.summary: Expect to see quite a few websites serving "404" or "Page Not Found" errors today: Nearly 70 percent of websites need to update their core software to fix a pair of vulnerabilities that allow an attacker to seize full control over affected servers. Experts say there are working exploits for the flaws, and that these critical bugs are already being exploited in the wild.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.summary: Pile-ups on both sides of a motorway killed at least 12 people and left as many as 48 injured in Bulgaria, the European Union country with deadliest roads.
